messages:
Emily: Quick sync on Invite Drawer v3I uploaded a new Figma frame. Main open items: SSO control placement, keyboard flow for role chips, audit-log deep-linking UX, and the language for success state. Figma: https://figma.com/file/xyz789 (Invite Drawer - accessibility pass).
Miguel: My instinct is to surface SSO status but not allow toggling here. Users expect invite-level controls; if enabling is org-scoped it feels dangerous to pretend otherwise. Could be a read-only status with a link.
Ken: For keyboard users, read-only still needs to be tabbable so they hear the rationale. Proposed order: email input -> role multiselect -> SSO status (tabbable) -> send. That keeps primary actions first.
Sasha: Contrast issue: the muted helper line under SSO status drops below 4.5:1 at small sizes. Recommend a darker token or move the explanatory copy off-canvas as SR-only and provide a short inline hint that meets contrast. Also chips need a 3px visible focus ring.
Noah: Backend note: org SSO is writable via Org Settings API only. We can deep-link to settings with ?source=invite&return=drawer. Backend can accept that param and the UI can return user to drawer state if they navigate back.
Lina: UX suggestion: instead of a disabled toggle, show a compact pill: "SSO enforced" or "SSO not enforced" with an info icon. Clicking info opens a modal that explains scope and includes a "Go to Organization settings" button. This reduces control confusion.
Miguel: I like Lina's pill. Copy idea for pill tooltip: "SSO enforcement applies to the entire organization. Change it in Organization Settings." Shorten for pill: "SSO enforced (org)".
Ken: Accessibility snippet for pill to be tabbable and announceable:
```
<button class="pill" role="button" aria-haspopup="dialog" aria-label="SSO enforcement status: enforced for this organization">SSO enforced</button>
```
Ensure the dialog is modal and focus-trapped.
Sasha: For the modal, include a dismiss button with accessible name and ensure pressing Esc returns focus to the pill. Modal must also include a visible close control and the "Go to Organization settings" CTA should be keyboard-focusable first in the modal content.
Emily: Audit log flow question: should "View changes" land users on Audit Logs with filters applied (actor + action=invite) or open a compact changelog inside the drawer?
Noah: Both are doable. I recommend deep-link to Audit Logs for full context, but we can show a short inline changelog (last 5 entries) in the confirmation drawer to avoid context switching. Deep-link params: actorId, action=invite, objectType=member, startTime, endTime. We'll support them.
Miguel: Copy tweak for confirmation state: instead of "Invites sent" use "Invites queued" + link to "View invite status" that opens the new Invite status page. Also make toast message less assertive: "Invites queued 3 recipients will receive emails shortly".
Sasha: Toasts must not steal focus. Use aria-live="polite" and ensure they disappear after 6s. Also provide an inline link in the drawer for power users to "Open invite status" so keyboard users can reach the status without relying on transient toast.
DeployBot: Visual regression: invite-drawer-v3 failed (focus-ring thickness and chip spacing). See diff: https://ci.internal/snapshots/2130054321/diff.png
Ken: I'll add CSS fixes: focus ring to 3px high-contrast, increase chip horizontal padding by 4px. Will put a sample CSS diff in PR.
Lina: Small copy ask: change placeholder from "Add role" to "Add role(s) — press Enter to confirm" to help discoverability for keyboard users.
Emily: Action list: Miguel update Figma with pill + modal copy, Ken add tabbable pill/modal ARIA and CSS fixes, Sasha create a short a11y checklist for drawer (contrast, focus rings, aria-live toasts, modal trapping), Noah spec deep-link query params and return flow, Lina update placeholder and small copy tweaks. Meeting: I'll follow up tomorrow 11am PT to check updated frames. :thumbsup:
Miguel: Will update today and ping the thread.
Ken: Adding PR notes now.
Sasha: I'll run axe on the updated frames and report back.
Noah: I'll draft the Audit Logs handler and share example links.
Emily: Thanks all, closing thread unless blockers surface.
